relevance_note: Single-patient imaging case report of a girl with Alexander disease "confirmed genetically by the identification of a mutation in the GFAP-gene".
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short script whose values were typed from the reading. One in-scope person (label 'patient', rule 5). The GFAP variant is not described (only 'a mutation in the GFAP-gene'), so the variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported'. Age 13 months recorded as age at last evaluation (age at admission/report); no age at diagnosis or onset stated. 'apicoposerior' is the paper's own spelling. 'feeding difficulties' not mapped to the dysphagia checklist item and 'psychomotor regression' not mapped to cognitive decline (broader/different concepts); brainstem T2 changes not mapped to the medulla/cervical cord item because the medulla is not named; contrast enhancement is mentioned only as a general disease feature, not for this patient. No contradictions found.
